open: PERF NOT MEASURED. Four other agents' render suites were on the box the whole session (frame_lab.tscn, night_contrast.tscn); every wall-clock number here would be noise. The added per-frame cost is one Rect2 loop over ~50 boxes per word plus [P17].chrome_rects() once per frame — INTEGRATOR must confirm against the real budget.

tests/d7/run_layout_audit.tscn --force-ui NEVER PRINTS A VERDICT ON THIS BOX, and that is NOT my change. Run twice under xvfb at 15 and 12 minutes: the current tree stalls at t000241 after cycling most lenses; a scratch git worktree at fff1b4e~1 — the commit BEFORE any of my work, no label_field.gd in it at all — stalls EARLIER, at t000020. Its own 220 s watchdog fires in neither. Four other agents' render suites (frame_lab.tscn, night_contrast.tscn) were on the four cores throughout. So: this suite is unverified for my change, it is unverified for the code before my change, and a gate suite that can outlive its own watchdog is worth INTEGRATOR's attention on a quiet box regardless of what it then says about [P19].

tools/check.sh WAS NOT RUN END TO END (40+ min against a box running three other agents' visual suites). Ran by hand and green: parse (442 scripts), --part=overlays (75 tests / 754 asserts), --part=hud (40 tests / 172 asserts), run_hud_view.tscn (192 checks), run_lens_density.tscn (99 checks), run_reachability.tscn --force-ui (92 checks, 0 unchecked), determinism.sh (IDENTICAL x2).

KNOWN LIMIT, visible in artifacts/G2_vis3/shots/build.png: GRID 3 is three tiles wide and every one of them sits inside the clock panel's rectangle, so its badge has nowhere honest to go and is not drawn. The lens offers 12 anchors per grid (north-to-south members, then the underside of the southern edge) and takes the first clear one; when a whole grid is behind a panel there is no clear one. The legend still names it with its hue and 'NO SOURCE', which is the fact that matters, and inventing a position for the badge would be a lie about where the grid is. If [P16] ever adds a leader line from chrome to world this is the case for it.

[P17]/[P18]/[P22]: the keep-out list is built from the `lcn_hud_chrome` group's `chrome_rects()`. [P18]'s build menu (layer 74) and [P22]'s dilemma card (66) are NOT in that group, so a lens word can still be drawn under them. It reads better than the clock did because both are near-opaque, but if either wants to be keep-out it needs `chrome_rects()` and that group — LcnOverlayRoot._chrome_world() picks it up with no change on my side.

[P19] follow-up not taken this wave: the merged status markers are capped to four badge-widths of reach (MARK_EXTENT), which at zoom 0.62 over a 230-building city still leaves 40 markers on screen. They are 22 px discs with glyphs, not words, and the critic counted chips — but if 'marks' is the next number a critic reads, the answer is a second merge pass keyed on problem rather than on distance.
